assumptions.claim_scope: The tests establish finite response identities and limitations of specified probes. Geometry-emergence claims require new models and independent tests.

recovered.average_response: signed and absolute response under the supplied uniform context measure
recovered.context_response: exact paired effect of each basic intervention on each observed bit
recovered.finite_probe_identifiability: which declared candidate systems survive the observed finite probe transcript
recovered.maximum_response: existence of a responding context within the declared intervention class
recovered.order_diagnostics: acyclicity and transitivity of register relations after collapsing update times

supplied.basic_interventions: set one initial register to zero or one while holding all other initial registers equal
supplied.clock: a global integer tick with a supplied forward update direction
supplied.context_measure: uniform measure used only for average-response diagnostics
supplied.contexts: all finite initial contexts are available in the exhaustive checks
supplied.dynamics: a specified simultaneous Boolean update map
supplied.observation: chosen register values after a declared number of updates
supplied.representation_cost: the primitive number of registers and Boolean rules is recorded; a universal coding prior remains unspecified

underdetermined.Einstein_variables: selection of a metric, tetrad or connection remains open
underdetermined.Lorentzian_signature: metric signature remains an open target
underdetermined.Newton_coupling: an independently defined gravitational response observable is required
underdetermined.manifold: a continuum limit and smooth atlas require additional arguments
underdetermined.null_cones: a universal relativistic characteristic cone requires a further dynamical result
underdetermined.spacetime_dimension: an emergent dimension requires a scale-sensitive observable beyond register counts

finite_horizon_ambiguity.protocol: set register 0 at tick 0; initialize others to zero; observe only last register
